reason: A CLI and agent plugin that analyzes shell commands, intercepts potentially destructive operations, requests confirmation when configured, and records policy and audit data.

summaries.zh: 用于在编码智能体执行终端命令前分析潜在破坏性操作，并按策略放行、拒绝或请求人工确认。
summaries.en: A CLI and agent plugin that analyzes terminal commands before execution and applies policy-based allow, deny, or human-confirmation decisions for potentially destructive operations.

capabilities: Parses shell command syntax and identifies potentially destructive operations
Interposes before agent tool execution and returns allow, ask, or deny decisions
Requests interactive confirmation and can execute commands through the gate wrapper
Persists policy overrides and JSONL audit records
